subject: [video] WP04 READY (harness 6122/6122; P-slice integration blocked on WP03 CAVLC gate)
body:
WP04's owned files are implemented, committed (c57fe0b, only gpu/video/avc/n2avc_{me,inter,rc}.c, n2avc_inter_priv.h and avc/test/inter/**), and host-tested.

COMMAND AND LAST LINE
  WP04_NO_INTEGRATION=1 bash gpu/video/avc/test/inter/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST WP04 PASS 6122/6122
  (ASan+UBSan diamond 1996/1996; ASan+UBSan -DN2AVC_ME_FULL with n2vk_me16 2130/2130; TSan four slice threads 1996/1996; iOS arm64 -Werror compile of the three sources.)

REAL INTEGRATION ALREADY PASSING
  static 176x144 x10, QP26, threads1, real WP03+WP04 CLI -> IDR is I_PCM 38261 B, P pictures 10 B each, ffmpeg decode == n2avc_reconstruction byte for byte (STATIC-BIT-EXACT). This exercises P_Skip, mb_skip_run, slice headers and the P plumbing end to end without WP03's CAVLC.
  On WP09's actual 176x144 pan vector frames 0/1, n2avc_me_search returns (12,-8) for all 99 MBs (interior SAD 0).

BLOCKED, NOT WP04
  bash gpu/video/avc/test/inter/run_tests.sh (which calls integration.sh --quick) stops at the WP03 intra gate: noise 176x144 QP20 one-picture --intra-only is not byte-exact; ffmpeg says 'corrupted macroblock 0 0 (total_coeff=16)'. My integration.sh therefore does not claim the P matrix / group-3 sizes / real RC / 1280x720 speed yet. The harness itself is green; WP04_NO_INTEGRATION=1 gives the 6122/6122 run above.
  The gate is WP03's own file (run_before direction + total_zeros + the n2bw_trailing overflow spin + the remaining CAVLC/level bug). I have not edited it. As soon as WP03's noise QP20 intra round trip is byte-exact I will run the full matrix (176/178/640/1280 x squares/pan/static x QP20/32/44 x threads1/4 + bitrates 300k/2M + 60-picture RC + speed) and post the measured numbers.

Also posted: build_ios.sh full link currently fails on pthread_* / _fprintf (WP03) and __tlv_bootstrap (WP08), not on WP04. My three files compile for iOS.

STATUS.json is in avc/test/inter/; the handoff note with pasted output is dsh/workers/WP04/STATUS.md. I stay on the board for review requests and will rerun the integration when WP03 announces.
